summary: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to a Membership Interest Purchase and Sale Agreement with CRH Funding II Pte. Ltd. The amendment fully satisfies milestone payments originally tied to the Lucky Shot Project acquisition by replacing them with a $5 million cash payment and 100,000 newly issued shares of common stock. The shares are to be issued by July 6, 2026. This is a settlement of contingent consideration, not a new acquisition or divestiture. No premium, price per share, or expected close was stated. The press release also noted a cash distribution from the Peak Gold JV. There is no special-situation event; it is a modification of prior deal terms.
